meta.title: Role-Based Data Restrictions: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role in the specified Enterprise tenant
Use Role-Based Data Restrictions to test vendor data access, downloads, and deletion for the non-admin user
Repeat the same actions as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant
Compare whether each action is refused or absent for the non-admin and available for the Tenant Admin
Verify or record the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role in the specified Enterprise tenant; Use Role-Based Data Restrictions to test vendor data access, downloads, and deletion for the non-admin user; Repeat the same actions as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant; Compare whether each action is refused or absent for the non-admin and available for the Tenant Admin; Verify or record the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and then a Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant, perform the vendor data access, download, and deletion actions under Role-Based Data Restrictions, and compare whether each action is refused or absent versus available

steps.note: The catalog cannot provision or switch user roles, configure RBAC, or execute and observe these role-specific vendor-data actions.
Confirm the session remains usable after the tester completes or reports the role comparison.
